query:
UPDATE trips
            SET start_date        = COALESCE($2::timestamptz, start_date),
                start_location_id = COALESCE($3::int, start_location_id),
                end_location_id   = COALESCE($4::int, end_location_id),
                available_seats   = COALESCE($5::int, available_seats)
          WHERE id = $1
          RETURNING id
